newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday, issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said most of the rates moved in a narrow range today with state-run banks based in Beijing and Shanghai acting as net lenders.

Many non-bank financial institutions, including major securities houses, traded early-maturing contracts due to an active domestic A share market in Shanghai, making the three-day contract the most active contract today, they said.
Traders said there was a balance of money demand and supply on the market and the rates were likely to continue to move in a narrow range in the near future.
